title: The localized counit comparison square for a quasi-isomorphism
statement: Let $f:X\to S$, $f':X'\to S'$, $g:S'\to S$, and $g':X'\to X$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme] forming a cartesian square [def-pc-base-change], with chosen derived categories of module sheaves. Let $s:P\to G$ be a quasi-isomorphism of arbitrary cochain complexes of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. For $z\in X'$ and $i\in\mathbf Z$, let $M_P$ and $M_G$ be the canonical cohomology models [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model] with actual stalk-ring actions [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. Write $L_P$ and $L_G$ for their localizedComparison maps in degree $i$, $J_P$ and $J_G$ for the homology maps of tensorStalkIso, and $T_s$ for the homology map of the stalk of termwise tensor pullback of $s$. There exists an isomorphism $e:\operatorname{dom}(L_P)\simeq\operatorname{dom}(L_G)$ of $\mathcal O_{X',z}$-modules such that $T_s\circ J_P\circ L_P=J_G\circ L_G\circ e$. No invertibility of either $L_P$, $L_G$, or $T_s$ is assumed.

proof.text: Stalks preserve homology: obtain preservation of exact short complexes from module_stalk_exact, and apply Functor.preservesHomology_of_map_exact. Hence the stalk of s is a quasi-isomorphism. Apply the general localized model comparison transport theorem to the actual stalk-ring models, and extend its cohomology isomorphism to C by Functor.mapIso.

Prove naturality of tensorStalkIso directly in a private proved helper. Use its specified components from exists_tensorStalkIso. Generalize the A-to-C stalk map and its equality to gprime.stalkMap, eliminate this equality, and apply naturality of the inverse of the natural pullback-stalk isomorphism. Apply HomologicalComplex.homologyMap to this chain square. Precompose with localizedComparison and substitute the algebraic square from step 1; reassociation gives exactly the displayed identity.

theorem exists_localizedComparison_quasiIso_square
    (P G : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (s : P ⟶ G) (hs : QuasiIso s) (z : X') (i : ℤ) :
    letI := leftAlgebra f g' z
    letI := rightAlgebra f f' g g' sq z
    letI := (tensorMap f f' g g' sq z).toAlgebra
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (R f g' z))
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (B f' z))
    ∃ e : (Arrow.mk ((cohomologyModel f f' g g' sq z P).localizedComparison i)).left ≅
        (Arrow.mk ((cohomologyModel f f' g g' sq z G).localizedComparison i)).left,
      (cohomologyModel f f' g g' sq z P).localizedComparison i ≫
          HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (tensorStalkIso f f' g g' sq z P).hom i ≫
          HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
            (((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X'.toRingedSpace z).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.up ℤ)).map
                (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map s)) i =
        e.hom ≫ (cohomologyModel f f' g g' sq z G).localizedComparison i ≫
          HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (tensorStalkIso f f' g g' sq z G).hom i
